definitions: The belief that anyone, regardless of where they were born or what class they were born into, can attain their own version of success in a society where upward mobility is possible for everyone.

A national ethos of the United States, the set of ideals (democracy, rights, liberty, opportunity, and equality) in which freedom includes the opportunity for prosperity and success, as well as an upward social mobility for the family and children, achieved through hard work in a society with few barriers.
examples: Many immigrants come to the United States seeking to achieve the American dream.
For some, owning a home is the ultimate American dream.
The pursuit of the American dream often involves significant sacrifice and hard work.
